branch.description: Nixpkgs branch to check when no flake path is configured
branch.label: Fallback branch

clean_command.description: Command to run when clicking Clean button
clean_command.label: Clean command

close_on_enter.description: Add 'Press enter to exit' on the terminal window
close_on_enter.label: Close on press Enter

flake_input.description: Flake input whose locked and upstream revisions are compared

nixos_configuration.description: NixOS configuration output rebuilt after updating the monitored flake input

generation_check_interval.description: How often to check NixOS and Home Manager generations (in minutes)
generation_check_interval.label: Generation check interval

hide_clean_button.description: Whether to hide the clean button on the panel

hide_optimize_button.description: Whether to hide the optimize button on the panel

hide_update_button.description: Whether to hide the update button on the panel
hide_update_button.label: Hide update button

optimize_command.description: Command to run when clicking Optimize button
optimize_command.label: Optimize command

show_update_available_notification.description: Whether to show a notification whenever an update is available
show_update_available_notification.label: Show update available notification

show_update_check_notification.description: Whether to show a notification whenever update check is in progress and completed
show_update_check_notification.label: Show update check notification

system_stats_check_duration_threshold.description: Cancel system stats check if it took too long (in minutes)

system_stats_check_interval.description: How often to check for system stats (in minutes)

update_check_interval.description: How often to check for updates (in minutes)
